canonicalIdentity: The course's one graded final MCQ is the existing course assessment sql-module-check (course.json assessments), now MCQ only; its legacy coding part was retired on 2026-11-10 because it duplicated the separate graded practical. There is no second exam.
valueFree: This map holds planned item ids, objectives, levels and abstract contexts only. No stem, option, keyed answer, feedback or scoring value is in this repository.
teachingBase: Landed teaching bytes: JDBC bridge teaching head 34b23353, merged to main by PR 89 at 2513e634; jdbc-data-access and the review pages are byte-identical between the two, so this map stands on the landed bytes.

count.rule: Course owner decision 2026-11-09: 2 minutes per question, at most 45 questions; 30 in 60 minutes is acceptable when it gives full applied all-topic coverage. No forced 45, no invented minimum, no per-question timer.

items.stepUp: Diagnosis from combined server, database and client evidence instead of naming one command.

itemConstraints: Every item uses only concepts taught on published course learner pages (and the Java Foundations prerequisites); every API, error text and psql command in an item appears on a course page.
No item reuses or lightly rewords a stem from a topic GIFT bank, a page activity or a Course Review page; each differs as stated in differsFrom and stepUp.
Exactly one keyed option of four, keyed positions balanced and not cyclic, feedback for every option.
Each SQL and Java outcome is executed where an offline engine matches PostgreSQL or Java semantics, otherwise checked against the official documentation the course pages cite.
